literal: The learning that oneself learned in one birth, to a person, even through seven births, protection it possesses.
translation: The learning that a person acquires in one birth will serve as a protective shield for them throughout all seven of their future births.
modern: ஒருவன் ஒரு பிறவியில் கற்ற கல்வியானது, அவனுக்கு ஏழு பிறவிகளிலும் பாதுகாப்பாக விளங்கும் தன்மை உடையது.
explanation: This couplet highlights the permanent and transcendent value of education. The word 'ஒருமை' refers to a single lifetime, while 'எழுமை' denotes the concept of seven successive births. The poet explains that the knowledge one acquires ('கற்ற கல்வி') is never lost; instead, it accompanies the soul as a constant source of strength and protection ('ஏமாப்பு') across all future existences. Thus, education is described as the only true wealth that remains with a person eternally.
